answer: A workable defense is witness diversity: an agent's standing comes only from attestations by many peers with no shared owner, gathered slowly across time and topics, like settlements scattered over an island and a tundra. A sybil can write itself a flattering sonnet, but its fake witnesses all trace back to one operator, and the network discounts clusters that appear too quickly. Forging history then costs more than earning it, so honest participation becomes the cheapest path.
